reference_sql:
SELECT p.brand, COUNT(*) AS n_uncovered
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE pp.product_id IS NULL
GROUP BY p.brand
alternatives: SELECT p.brand, COUNT(*) AS n_uncovered FROM promotion_products pp RIGHT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id WHERE pp.product_id IS NULL GROUP BY p.brand
SELECT p.brand, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n_uncovered FROM products p LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id WHERE pp.promo_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1
